entries.text: Fixed DataFrame plan capture writing absolute local file paths (home directory, working directory, data directories) into the .plans.json companion; plan text now shows <redacted> in place of the local path prefix.
details: Affected existing results: any .plans.json produced by --capture-plans on DataFrame platforms (notably polars-df, also datafusion-df and the Spark-family DataFrame platforms) before this release can contain local Parquet paths in plan.plan_text, plan.plan_data.logical_plan/optimized_plan and raw_explain_output.
Regenerate those results with --capture-plans (or strip the paths) before publishing; the result JSON itself is unchanged apart from the test_type field noted below.

Only local path prefixes change: for known data and working directories the remainder of the path is kept, so scan table names and DAG fingerprints are preserved; paths under the home directory or any other unknown location are replaced whole. Polars text plans carry no fingerprint.

entries.text: Fixed DataFrame query rows missing a test type, so plan companion keys for DataFrame platforms were written as Q1#0: instead of Q1#0:power like SQL platforms.
details: Affected existing results: DataFrame .plans.json companions keyed Q#<stream>: keep loading and rendering unchanged; the explorer and loader accept both key shapes. Regenerate a result to get Q#<stream>:power keys; no republishing is required for key shape alone.
Regenerated DataFrame result JSON query rows now include test_type: "power".
